verdict.rationale: Omarchy's own docs say the firewall is enabled by default and describe the default inbound policy, with exceptions for port 22 (SSH) and port 53317 (LocalSend). That meets the story of a firewall that works out of the box with no manual setup. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the firewall tool and how to manage its rules, independent or hands-on confirmation that it is active after install.

support.subject: As a switcher, I get a default firewall enabled automatically without manual configuration
